question: Find all employees (emp_id, emp_name) who do not manage any other employees.
human_sql: SELECT a.emp_id, a.emp_name FROM employees a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM employees sub WHERE sub.manager_id = a.emp_id);

question: For each employee with transactions, find their single highest sales record (break ties by smallest order_id) and its difference from their personal average (emp_id, order_id, max_val, diff_avg).
human_sql: WITH R AS (SELECT emp_id, order_id, total_amount, AVG(total_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY emp_id) AS avg_a, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY emp_id ORDER BY total_amount DESC, order_id ASC) AS rn FROM sales_orders) SELECT emp_id, order_id, total_amount AS max_val, total_amount - avg_a AS diff_avg FROM R WHERE rn = 1;

question: Find all non-empty departments (dept_id, dept_name) where EVERY employee is certified in ALL mandatory skills (is_mandatory = 1).
human_sql: SELECT g.dept_id, g.dept_name FROM departments g WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM employees a WHERE a.dept_id = g.dept_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM employees a WHERE a.dept_id = g.dept_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM skills r WHERE r.is_mandatory = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM emp_skills b WHERE b.emp_id = a.emp_id AND b.skill_id = r.skill_id)));

question: Find employees (emp_id, emp_name, tot) whose 2025 total sales strictly exceeded their 2025 quota, AND whose total certifications exceed their department's average (including zero-certification members).
human_sql: WITH T AS (SELECT emp_id, SUM(total_amount) AS tot FROM sales_orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY emp_id), C AS (SELECT a.emp_id, a.dept_id, COUNT(b.skill_id) AS cnt FROM employees a LEFT JOIN emp_skills b ON a.emp_id = b.emp_id GROUP BY a.emp_id, a.dept_id), A AS (SELECT emp_id, cnt, AVG(cnt * 1.0) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_id) AS g_avg FROM C) SELECT a.emp_id, a.emp_name, t.tot FROM employees a JOIN T t ON a.emp_id = t.emp_id JOIN sales_targets q ON a.emp_id = q.emp_id AND q.target_year = 2025 JOIN A ag ON a.emp_id = ag.emp_id WHERE t.tot > q.target_amount AND ag.cnt > ag.g_avg;

question: Find employees (emp_id, emp_name, dept_id, salary) earning strictly more than their department's average salary, ONLY in departments whose 2025 total sales exceed the organization-wide average across all departments.
human_sql: WITH GT AS (SELECT g.dept_id, COALESCE(SUM(t.total_amount), 0) AS g_tot FROM departments g LEFT JOIN employees a ON g.dept_id = a.dept_id LEFT JOIN sales_orders t ON a.emp_id = t.emp_id AND t.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND t.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY g.dept_id), AP AS (SELECT emp_id, emp_name, dept_id, salary, AVG(salary) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_id) AS avg_p FROM employees) SELECT emp_id, emp_name, dept_id, salary FROM AP WHERE dept_id IN (SELECT dept_id FROM GT WHERE g_tot > (SELECT AVG(g_tot) FROM GT)) AND salary > avg_p;

question: Classify each employee's 2025 tier (emp_id, emp_name, tier): 'Achiever' if 2025 sales >= 50000; 'Top Star' if 2025 sales >= 100000 AND certified in all mandatory skills; otherwise 'Needs Improvement'.
human_sql: WITH M AS (SELECT a.emp_id, a.emp_name, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(t.total_amount) FROM sales_orders t WHERE t.emp_id = a.emp_id AND t.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND t.order_date < '2026-01-01'), 0) AS s25, CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM skills r WHERE r.is_mandatory = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM emp_skills b WHERE b.emp_id = a.emp_id AND b.skill_id = r.skill_id)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS all_m FROM employees a) SELECT emp_id, emp_name, CASE WHEN s25 >= 100000 AND all_m = 1 THEN 'Top Star' WHEN s25 >= 50000 THEN 'Achiever' ELSE 'Needs Improvement' END AS tier FROM M;

question: Return emp_id, emp_name, xmoney, and showcost. xmoney is 10% of 2025 sales if 2025 sales > 2025 quota, else 0. showcost is salary + xmoney if they manage anyone; else intermediate NULL replaced with salary.
human_sql: WITH M AS (SELECT a.emp_id, a.emp_name, a.salary, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(t.total_amount) FROM sales_orders t WHERE t.emp_id = a.emp_id AND t.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND t.order_date < '2026-01-01'), 0) AS s25, (SELECT q.target_amount FROM sales_targets q WHERE q.emp_id = a.emp_id AND q.target_year = 2025) AS q25, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM employees sub WHERE sub.manager_id = a.emp_id) AS is_b FROM employees a), B AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN q25 IS NOT NULL AND s25 > q25 THEN s25 * 0.10 ELSE 0.0 END AS xmoney FROM M) SELECT emp_id, emp_name, xmoney, COALESCE(CASE WHEN is_b THEN salary + xmoney ELSE NULL END, salary) AS showcost FROM B;

question: Find all non-empty wards (ward_id, ward_name) where EVERY doctor is certified in ALL core safety protocols (is_core_safety = 1).

question: Find doctors (doc_id, doc_name, tot) whose 2025 total treatment billing strictly exceeded their 2025 quota, AND whose total certifications exceed their ward's average (including zero-certification members).
human_sql: WITH T AS (SELECT doc_id, SUM(bill_amount) AS tot FROM treatments WHERE treat_date >= '2025-01-01' AND treat_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY doc_id), C AS (SELECT a.doc_id, a.ward_id, COUNT(b.proto_id) AS cnt FROM doctors a LEFT JOIN doc_protocols b ON a.doc_id = b.doc_id GROUP BY a.doc_id, a.ward_id), A AS (SELECT doc_id, cnt, AVG(cnt * 1.0) OVER (PARTITION BY ward_id) AS g_avg FROM C) SELECT a.doc_id, a.doc_name, t.tot FROM doctors a JOIN T t ON a.doc_id = t.doc_id JOIN claim_coverage q ON a.doc_id = q.doc_id AND q.budget_year = 2025 JOIN A ag ON a.doc_id = ag.doc_id WHERE t.tot > q.quota_amount AND ag.cnt > ag.g_avg;

question: Find doctors (doc_id, doc_name, ward_id, base_fee) earning strictly more than their ward's average base fee, ONLY in wards whose 2025 total treatment billing exceed the organization-wide average across all wards.
human_sql: WITH GT AS (SELECT g.ward_id, COALESCE(SUM(t.bill_amount), 0) AS g_tot FROM wards g LEFT JOIN doctors a ON g.ward_id = a.ward_id LEFT JOIN treatments t ON a.doc_id = t.doc_id AND t.treat_date >= '2025-01-01' AND t.treat_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY g.ward_id), AP AS (SELECT doc_id, doc_name, ward_id, base_fee, AVG(base_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY ward_id) AS avg_p FROM doctors) SELECT doc_id, doc_name, ward_id, base_fee FROM AP WHERE ward_id IN (SELECT ward_id FROM GT WHERE g_tot > (SELECT AVG(g_tot) FROM GT)) AND base_fee > avg_p;

question: Classify each doctor's 2025 tier (doc_id, doc_name, tier): 'Standard' if 2025 treatment billing >= 80000; 'Senior Fellow' if 2025 treatment billing >= 150000 AND certified in all core safety protocols; otherwise 'Probation'.

question: Return doc_id, doc_name, xmoney, and showcost. xmoney is 10% of 2025 treatment billing if 2025 treatment billing > 2025 quota, else 0. showcost is base_fee + xmoney if they supervise anyone; else intermediate NULL replaced with base_fee.

question: Find all loan officers (officer_id, officer_name) who do not approve loans for any other loan officers.

question: Find all non-empty branchs (branch_id, branch_name) where EVERY loan officer is certified in ALL statutory licenses (is_statutory = 1).

question: Find loan officers (officer_id, officer_name, tot) whose 2025 total loan principal strictly exceeded their 2025 quota, AND whose total certifications exceed their branch's average (including zero-certification members).
human_sql: WITH T AS (SELECT officer_id, SUM(principal_amount) AS tot FROM loan_disbursements WHERE disburse_date >= '2025-01-01' AND disburse_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY officer_id), C AS (SELECT a.officer_id, a.branch_id, COUNT(b.lic_id) AS cnt FROM loan_officers a LEFT JOIN officer_licenses b ON a.officer_id = b.officer_id GROUP BY a.officer_id, a.branch_id), A AS (SELECT officer_id, cnt, AVG(cnt * 1.0) OVER (PARTITION BY branch_id) AS g_avg FROM C) SELECT a.officer_id, a.officer_name, t.tot FROM loan_officers a JOIN T t ON a.officer_id = t.officer_id JOIN portfolio_quotas q ON a.officer_id = q.officer_id AND q.quota_year = 2025 JOIN A ag ON a.officer_id = ag.officer_id WHERE t.tot > q.target_principal AND ag.cnt > ag.g_avg;

question: Find loan officers (officer_id, officer_name, branch_id, retainer_salary) earning strictly more than their branch's average retainer salary, ONLY in branchs whose 2025 total loan principal exceed the organization-wide average across all branchs.
human_sql: WITH GT AS (SELECT g.branch_id, COALESCE(SUM(t.principal_amount), 0) AS g_tot FROM branches g LEFT JOIN loan_officers a ON g.branch_id = a.branch_id LEFT JOIN loan_disbursements t ON a.officer_id = t.officer_id AND t.disburse_date >= '2025-01-01' AND t.disburse_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY g.branch_id), AP AS (SELECT officer_id, officer_name, branch_id, retainer_salary, AVG(retainer_salary) OVER (PARTITION BY branch_id) AS avg_p FROM loan_officers) SELECT officer_id, officer_name, branch_id, retainer_salary FROM AP WHERE branch_id IN (SELECT branch_id FROM GT WHERE g_tot > (SELECT AVG(g_tot) FROM GT)) AND retainer_salary > avg_p;

question: Classify each loan officer's 2025 tier (officer_id, officer_name, tier): 'Qualified' if 2025 loan principal >= 250000; 'Prime Underwriter' if 2025 loan principal >= 500000 AND certified in all statutory licenses; otherwise 'Restricted'.
